reviewDecisions.rationale: Record heavy-truck demand is economically direct and measurable; duration and company-level conversion need deep verification.
The profit inflection is real and electronics/special machinery show unusual resilience, but only narrow causal expressions may qualify.
The physical cycle remains positive but expected duration is weakening; this is a strong test of good-news-is-already-priced discipline.
Weak upstream pricing should prevent a hindsight-driven solar scarcity thesis unless a verified company engine independently overrides it.
The gold cash-flow engine is real, but the multi-year-high price state makes expectation absorption central.
Infrastructure demand is visible in raw materials, but deep research must separate beneficiaries from broad cyclical beta.
Broad manufacturing recovery is context, not a narrow listed-company thesis.
